query: Run node tools/probe.mjs FIRST so the actual environment failure is observed. Then inspect the script, fix only this invocation's environment, and rerun it successfully. Do not edit the probe. The successful output describes our verified recovery procedure. Explain the observed failure and successful fix briefly.
content:
Relevant remembered evidence. Use supported facts when applicable; current instructions take precedence.
<memory_recall>
[m_mvnwa7bb85d157bee77093dd6483] Ingestion acceptance, identity, quarantine, and recovery rules (project; user_statement; confidence 1.00; 2026-10-25)
Use a default batch size of 2 accepted records. Identify events by the pair (tenant, seq), never seq alone. Preserve original event objects and arrival order. Quarantine malformed input lines into `rejected.ndjson` and continue processing. Never erase existing output to recover a checkpoint.

[m_mvnwa7bgf4bd5b83ba747b5999a1] Auxiliary ingestion config must not leak into migration (project; user_statement; confidence 1.00; 2026-10-25)
For ingestion-only auxiliary configs, use region `us-west-9` and retry settings `maxAttempts: 11` and `backoffMs: 900`. Never apply these settings to the migration project.
